ServerCommand: Manage Hippotizer servers, consoles and DMX network nodes from your MA3 session.
AttributeClone: Clone selected fixture attributes with separate source and destination lists.
HippoRemote: Server Command's Hippo-only interface for selecting and controlling Hippotizer servers.
TourLocation: Set touring locations, session timezone and time synchronization settings.
TouchConfigurator: Remap touch surfaces and transfer views across your connected displays.
WingConfigurator: Identify executor surfaces, assign Wing IDs and organize your desk.
AutoColorPicker: Build a color picker from your Groups and Color presets in the current DataPool.
MASearch: Find DataPool objects and navigate to them through a dedicated search window.
CueBeacon: Create cue-driven executor beacons with configurable start and stop cues.
APIInfo: Export grandMA3 API information for plugin development and troubleshooting.
WadePluginUpdater: Scan drives, compare versions, and download or install your Wade plugins.
